summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review repaired the parser-generated activity gaps from primary XML tables and the local supplementary DOCX, reconciled linked database rows to source locators, and leaves only explicit nonblocking sequence/strain caveats.
adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework closed rwk-complete-test-0001 with cautions for modified-sequence normalization and one database strain spelling mismatch; no blocking or major rework target remains after strict gate rerun.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/package/DOCX/figure/database sources were sufficient to repair the worker-2/4/6 blockers; no missing local value remains as a publication-grade blocker.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Linked DBAASP/CAMP activity rows are reconciled to XML Table 1 or recovered Supplementary Table S1; modified sequence strings are kept as sequence_modified_not_normalized and the Yersinia CO92/C092 spelling mismatch is preserved as source_conflict.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: CMB001 MIC rows, resistance-frequency rows, and Acinetobacter supplementary MIC rows now have endpoint, raw value, unit or ratio, target, strain, assay context, and source locator. Comparator antibiotics are preserved as context rather than emitted as CMB001 rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Direct mechanism is limited to membrane-depolarization/growth-curve evidence; biofilm, resistance profile, and lipid-II/structure claims are separately classified with limitations.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_publication_grade: The previous framework-only gap is closed by paper-local source review. Remaining cautions are explicit and nonblocking.

caution_findings.evidence_context: CMB001 is a modified lantibiotic; DBAASP/CAMP sequence strings use placeholder/normalized residue encodings and are not exact unmodified peptide sequences.
Database row uses Yersinia pestis C092 while primary Table 1 uses CO92; retained as source_conflict with the MIC source locator.
Figure-only biofilm and depolarization traces were used for qualitative/source-located mechanism classification; exact curve values were not invented.
